meta.title: Yala-Gam3ya
meta.description: Organize your Gam3yas: due dates, payout turns and amounts — all in one place.

disclaimer.short: Yala-Gam3ya only organizes records — it never collects, holds or transfers money.
disclaimer.statuses: Recorded statuses are information entered by organizers or members, not verified bank transfers.

about.title: About Yala-Gam3ya
about.appBlurb: Yala-Gam3ya helps families and friends in Egypt organize their rotating savings groups — who pays when and who receives when — clearly, in one place. It only keeps records; it never collects or moves money.
about.bio: I build internal tools and automations that make day-to-day work smoother for Operations and Underwriting teams — from CRM workflows to data pipelines and full-stack web apps.
